description: Phase S0 frozen baseline definition for the SQLite storage runtime plan. Freezes the last released schema/binary identity and defines current, 10x, open-loop overload, crash, recovery, FTS, backup/restore, and A/A noise-floor workloads across the supported store families. Product command templates are intentionally null (pending) until the S0 evidence campaign wires the released binary's explicit commands; the runner fails closed on pending steps unless --allow-pending is passed. This file defines the contract; it is not yet evidence.

frozen_identity.notes: The schema manifest/config are operator-supplied released artifacts. The freeze binds binary, schema, workload, corpus, and config hashes; it never derives identity from a live profile.

safety.notes: The runner, not the workload, creates and sets TRACEDECAY_DATA_DIR/TRACEDECAY_GLOBAL_DB under each fresh runner-owned store copy. Protected child roots cannot be overridden; child processes never inherit TRACEDECAY_* implicitly.

latency.coordinated_omission: open-loop latency is measured from the scheduled issue time; closed-loop issues strictly sequentially

phases.name: current
phases.pending_reason: wire the released binary's explicit write/read mix commands against the isolated store copy

phases.name: ten_x
phases.pending_reason: same mix as current at 10x record volume

phases.name: overload
phases.pending_reason: wire offered-rate writes above sustainable throughput against the isolated copy
phases.notes: offered/admitted/completed/shed/retried are recorded per family; latency is measured from scheduled issue time so queueing is included

phases.name: crash
phases.pending_reason: wire long-running writer plus kill trigger and post-crash integrity evidence

phases.name: recovery
phases.pending_reason: wire reopen/verify command against the crashed store copy

phases.name: fts
phases.pending_reason: wire FTS MATCH/rank/snippet probe commands against the isolated copies of FTS-bearing families

phases.name: backup_restore
phases.pending_reason: wire backup-to-staging, manifest verification, and restore commands

phases.name: aa_noise
phases.notes: A/A pairs establish the per-platform noise floor; regression margins for current and 10x are noise_floor * margin_multiplier and must be re-recorded on Linux, Windows, and macOS

limitations: all product command templates are pending; this file is the S0 contract, not evidence
A/A noise floors are per-machine and must be re-baselined per platform
network filesystems are out of scope per the plan's fail-closed policy
